title: Dr Frost Arctic Coconut Lemonade Ice 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Dr Frost Arctic Shortfill Coconut Lemonade Ice combines the smooth, creamy taste of Coconut with the zesty sparkle of Lemonade, finished with a frosty menthol exhale. This tropical and refreshing blend delivers an exotic combination of fruit and ice, ideal for vapers who enjoy unique and bold e-liquid profiles. As part of Dr Frost’s Arctic Edition collection, this shortfill features double-concentrated ‘Bar Salts’ flavour, replicating the bold taste vapers appreciate in disposable vapes. Crafted with a 50VG/50PG ratio, it’s designed for low-powered Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) pod kits. The 100ml bottle leaves room for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing users to tailor their nicotine strength or enjoy it nicotine-free. Dr Frost Arctic Shortfills are a versatile and economical choice for adult smokers and vapers seeking bold flavours and exceptional value.
